import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

# Okabe-Ito palette
C_SIGLIP = '#0072B2'       # blue - SigLIP
C_VLA_T  = '#56B4E9'       # sky blue - VLA trained
C_VLA_U  = '#CC79A7'       # reddish purple - VLA untrained
C_DINO   = '#D55E00'       # vermillion - DINO

# Data (descending order)
labels = [
    'SigLIP\n+Projector',
    'VLA Trained\nw/ instr.',
    'VLA Trained\nno instr.',
    'VLA Untrained\nw/ instr.',
    'VLA Untrained\nno instr.',
    'DINOv2',
]
values = [0.615, 0.501, 0.501, 0.485, 0.482, 0.388]
colors = [C_SIGLIP, C_VLA_T, C_VLA_T, C_VLA_U, C_VLA_U, C_DINO]
hatches = ['', '', '///', '', '///', '']

# CI for SigLIP
siglip_ci_lo, siglip_ci_hi = 0.526, 0.695

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))

x = np.arange(len(labels))
bars = ax.bar(x, values, width=0.65, color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.6, zorder=3)

# Apply hatches for "no instruction" variants
for bar, h in zip(bars, hatches):
    bar.set_hatch(h)

# CI whisker on SigLIP
ax.errorbar(0, values[0],
            yerr=[[values[0] - siglip_ci_lo], [siglip_ci_hi - values[0]]],
            fmt='none', ecolor='black', capsize=4, capthick=1.2, linewidth=1.2, zorder=4)

# DINO baseline dashed line
ax.axhline(y=values[-1], color=C_DINO, linestyle='--', linewidth=0.9, alpha=0.6, zorder=1)
ax.text(len(labels) - 0.55, values[-1] + 0.008, 'DINO baseline',
        fontsize=8.5, color=C_DINO, ha='right', va='bottom', fontstyle='italic')

# Gap annotation between SigLIP and VLA mean
vla_mean = np.mean(values[1:5])
gap = values[0] - vla_mean
mid_y = (values[0] + vla_mean) / 2

# Draw bracket between bar 0 and bar 1
bx = 0.55
ax.annotate('', xy=(bx, values[0]), xytext=(bx, vla_mean),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#333333', lw=1.2,
                            shrinkA=2, shrinkB=2))
ax.text(bx + 0.12, mid_y, f'Δ = {gap:.3f}',
        fontsize=9, color='#333333', ha='left', va='center',
        fontweight='bold')

# Value labels on bars
for i, (xi, v) in enumerate(zip(x, values)):
    offset = (siglip_ci_hi - v + 0.015) if i == 0 else 0.012
    ax.text(xi, v + offset, f'{v:.3f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='medium')

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_ylabel(r'RSA with Action Space ($\rho$)')
ax.set_ylim(0.3, 0.78)
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, len(labels) - 0.5)

# Legend
legend_handles = [
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=C_SIGLIP, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5, label='SigLIP+Projector'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=C_VLA_T, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5, label='VLA Trained'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=C_VLA_U, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5, label='VLA Untrained'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=C_DINO, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5, label='DINOv2'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5, hatch='///', label='No instruction'),
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_handles, loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9, fontsize=8.5,
          handlelength=1.5, handleheight=1.2)

ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(plt.MultipleLocator(0.05))
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25, linewidth=0.5, zorder=0)

plt.tight_layout()

out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_15/projects/vla-ssd/artifacts/figures/paper'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig2.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig2.png')
print(f'Saved fig2.pdf and fig2.png to {out_dir}')

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

# Okabe-Ito palette
C_SIGLIP = '#0072B2'       # blue - SigLIP
C_VLA_T  = '#56B4E9'       # sky blue - VLA trained
C_VLA_U  = '#CC79A7'       # reddish purple - VLA untrained
C_DINO   = '#D55E00'       # vermillion - DINO

# Data (descending order)
labels = [
    'SigLIP\n+Proj.',
    'VLA-T\nw/ instr.',
    'VLA-T\nno instr.',
    'VLA-U\nw/ instr.',
    'VLA-U\nno instr.',
    'DINOv2',
]
values = [0.615, 0.501, 0.501, 0.485, 0.482, 0.388]
colors = [C_SIGLIP, C_VLA_T, C_VLA_T, C_VLA_U, C_VLA_U, C_DINO]
hatches = ['', '', '///', '', '///', '']

# CI for SigLIP
siglip_ci_lo, siglip_ci_hi = 0.526, 0.695

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))

x = np.arange(len(labels))
bars = ax.bar(x, values, width=0.65, color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.6, zorder=3)

# Apply hatches for "no instruction" variants
for bar, h in zip(bars, hatches):
    bar.set_hatch(h)

# CI whisker on SigLIP
ax.errorbar(0, values[0],
            yerr=[[values[0] - siglip_ci_lo], [siglip_ci_hi - values[0]]],
            fmt='none', ecolor='black', capsize=4, capthick=1.2, linewidth=1.2, zorder=4)

# DINO baseline dashed line
ax.axhline(y=values[-1], color=C_DINO, linestyle='--', linewidth=0.9, alpha=0.6, zorder=1)
ax.text(-0.4, values[-1] + 0.008, 'DINO baseline',
        fontsize=8.5, color=C_DINO, ha='left', va='bottom', fontstyle='italic')

# Gap annotation between SigLIP and VLA mean
vla_mean = np.mean(values[1:5])
gap = values[0] - vla_mean
mid_y = (values[0] + vla_mean) / 2

# Draw bracket between bar 0 and bar 1
bx = 0.55
ax.annotate('', xy=(bx, values[0]), xytext=(bx, vla_mean),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#333333', lw=1.2,
                            shrinkA=2, shrinkB=2))
ax.text(bx + 0.12, mid_y, f'Δ = {gap:.3f}',
        fontsize=9, color='#333333', ha='left', va='center',
        fontweight='bold')

# Value labels on bars
for i, (xi, v) in enumerate(zip(x, values)):
    offset = (siglip_ci_hi - v + 0.015) if i == 0 else 0.012
    ax.text(xi, v + offset, f'{v:.3f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='medium')

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_ylabel(r'RSA with Action Space ($\rho$)')
ax.set_ylim(0.3, 0.78)
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, len(labels) - 0.5)

# Legend
legend_handles = [
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=C_SIGLIP, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5, label='SigLIP+Projector'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=C_VLA_T, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5, label='VLA Trained'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=C_VLA_U, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5, label='VLA Untrained'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=C_DINO, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5, label='DINOv2'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5, hatch='///', label='No instruction'),
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_handles, loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9, fontsize=8.5,
          handlelength=1.5, handleheight=1.2)

ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(plt.MultipleLocator(0.05))
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25, linewidth=0.5, zorder=0)

plt.tight_layout()

out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_15/projects/vla-ssd/artifacts/figures/paper'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig2.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig2.png')
print(f'Saved fig2.pdf and fig2.png to {out_dir}')
